expected.insightNarrative:
Airlines Page is the airline page of the Airline Alliance Activity Dashboard, which follows the activity of the AeroLink alliance of four airlines from 2022 to 2025. One airline is chosen in the navigation on the left, along with the year, the month and the region; the dashboard shows SkyConnect Air for July 2023 in North America. A summary strip sits at the top, and three columns of monthly KPI cards follow, for passenger traffic, cargo traffic and cost and revenue. Each card gives the month's value, its change against the previous month, a bar chart of the twelve months of the year with a dot under each month marking whether it beat the same month of the prior year, and the current month highlighted.

Key insights
- SkyConnect Air completed 1,410 flights in the month, up 1.7% on the previous month, with on-time performance of 83.6% (up 2.9%), an average distance of 5,396.79 km (down 3.1%) and an average CSAT score of 7.9 (down 0.1%). Its hub is New York (JFK) and its major route Zurich to Tokyo (ZUR-NRT).
- Passenger traffic is at its highest levels of the year: 339,851 passengers in the selected month and up to 349,145 in December, revenue passenger kilometres of 1.78B in the month and up to 1.85B in June, and a passenger load factor of 90.38% in the month, peaking at 91.24% in June.
- Cargo peaks in the last quarter: freight tonnes reach 9,331 in December, 8,924 in November and 8,740 in October; cargo tonne kilometres 49.76M, 48.93M and 47.92M in the same months; and the cargo load factor is highest in November at 77.95%, with December at 77.56% and October at 77.54%.
- Revenue is high but profit is negative: total revenue reaches $601.19M in June and $581.76M in August, with $566.79M in the selected month and $564.49M in December, while operating profit is at its lowest in November at -$176.69M and October at -$171.22M.

Airline Summary 1, Airline Summary 2
The summary strip: 1,410 completed flights (up 1.7% versus the previous month), an average distance covered of 5,396.79 km (down 3.1%), on-time performance of 83.6% (up 2.9%), the airline hub at New York, United States (JFK), the major flight route Zurich, Switzerland to Tokyo, Japan (ZUR-NRT), and an average CSAT score of 7.9 (down 0.1%).

Passenger Count BAN, Pass Count Bars, Pass Count Circles, Pass Count Labels
All passengers for the month: 339,851, up 0.7% versus the previous month, with every month of the year above the prior year.

RPK Airlines BAN, RPK Airlines Bars, RPK Airlines Circles, RPK Airlines Labels
Revenue passenger kilometres: 1.78 billion km, down 3.8% versus the previous month.

Load Factor BAN, Load Factor Bars, Load Factor Circles, Load Factor Airlines Labels
Passenger load factor: 90.4%, down 0.9% versus the previous month.

Freight Tonnes BAN, Freight Tonnes Bars, Freight Tonnes Circles, Freight Tonnes Labels
Freight carried: 7,388 tonnes, up 1.3% versus the previous month.

CTK BAN, CTK Bars, CTK Circles, CTK Labels
Cargo tonne kilometres: 39.20 million km, down 4.3% versus the previous month.

CLF BAN, CLF Bars, CLF Circles, CLF Labels
Cargo load factor: 64.9%, down 0.5% versus the previous month.

Total Revenue BAN, Total Revenue Bars, Total Revenue Circles, Total Revenue Labels
Total revenue: $566.79M, down 5.7% versus the previous month.

Op Profit BAN, Op Profit Bars, Op Profit Circles, Op Profit Labels
Total operating profit: -$10.56M, down 193.4% versus the previous month; the bars for the summer months hang below zero and the last months of the year are marked in blue as losses against the prior year.

Cost BAN, Cost Bars, Cost Circles, Cost Labels
Total operating cost: $577.35M, down 2.1% versus the previous month; the dots under the months are red for costs that exceed the prior year's.

Years, Months, Selected Region, Airline Navigation, Logged in
The dashboard's controls: the year and month buttons, the region drop-down, the navigation menu with the alliance's four airlines, and the login greeting. They carry no measures of their own.
